title: Backflow reporting portal: find the official filing route
description: The correct portal is established by the issuing utility or authority, not search results.
prompt: How can the official reporting portal be verified before information is submitted?
answer: The correct portal is established by the issuing utility or authority, not search results. Confirm the official domain, property account, assembly, tester record, and receipt mechanism before entering data.
urgency: Do not send property or tester data to an unverified portal. Escalate rejected files or missing receipt evidence before the deadline.
identifiers: Official issuer links establish the authorized filing route.
A field test report can require owner or contractor action to become an accepted filing.
A rejection must be tied back to the exact assembly and resubmission owner.

choices.label: I have an official notice or requirement
choices.detail: Match it to the exact property and assembly before booking work.

choices.label: The device failed or needs service
choices.detail: Define repair, retest, and filing responsibility separately.

choices.label: I need a complete scope
choices.detail: Include access, testing, closeout, and documentation in the comparison.

steps.title: Establish the governing record
steps.body: Start at the issuer notice or website and verify the domain.

steps.title: Define the complete work
steps.body: Check all property, assembly, tester, date, and result fields before submission.

steps.title: Document completion
steps.body: Save confirmation and resolve rejection messages with the responsible party.

safeChecks: Use the exact property and assembly record before authorizing work.
Confirm official program and manufacturer information for the decision.
Keep the final result and submission evidence together.
stopConditions: The portal is not linked or named by the issuer.
Submission cannot be proven after upload.
notThisDevice: A generic product listing is not an approval record.
A different system type may require a different workflow.
This page does not replace a qualified on-site assessment.
evidenceNote: This path is governed by the official utility or authority requirement, then by exact manufacturer documentation for the identified assembly.
